rationale: Descriptor-mass dominance is proven independently on the base evidence path via C2 OOD commitment reversion and 7/12 held-out rank reductions. Descriptor-compression aliasing is proven independently on the sequence transition path via precompression pair superiority across 5/5 large regressions and 14/14 Q2 failures. Per Section 39, transition genericity is a downstream manifestation of compression aliasing, while mass expansion operates at the base evidence accumulation stage. Per Section 43, the earliest upstream mechanism is descriptor-mass dominance.
